name: harness-status
description: v0.1.11: cargo fmt --all reformatting only (fixes the 'build & commit plugin binaries' smoke workflow's `cargo fmt --all --check` gate, chronically red on main since 2026-07-21 per scripts/check-ci-red.py); no behavior change. Unified HOTL status dashboard for Claude Code. A /status command runs a bundled Rust binary that aggregates budgetguard's spend ledger, gauge's session records (recent sessions + cost), and taskprog's progress file into one human-on-the-loop view. Subscription-native (binary + command, no API key). A lightweight SessionStart hook additionally warns (fail-soft, silent when healthy) if a registered hook's binary is missing from disk, or if a stray PATH binary (e.g. a stale ~/.cargo/bin copy) shadows a plugin-cache copy of the same name.
